title: Day 5: an AI made a memory game you play by ear #shorts
description:
A memory game you play with your ears.

Ear Pairs is today's app in our series "AI ships an app a day": every day an AI builds a brand-new iPhone app from scratch, and we show you what it made.

The cards have no pictures. Flip one and it plays a sound. Find the pair with the same pitch, the same chord, or the same interval — by ear only. Telling sounds apart is the whole game, so your ear gets better as you play. A new board every day, plus 60 levels from single notes to octaves, chords and intervals.

Ear Pairs - coming soon to the App Store

The music in this video is made from scratch for this channel. Narration is a synthetic voice reading our own script.

Follow for Day 6 tomorrow.
